summary.text: Beth Gardner Helfrich is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 98 since January 1, 2025, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gardner Helfrich was born in North Carolina and earned a bachelor's degree from Davidson College.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a writer and editor, and says she worked as an English teacher and school leader or administrator from 2005 to 2020.
She took office in 2025, succeeding John Bradford III, a Republican.
